system.description: Homebrew: Murderous Arts I and II have been consolidated into this single talent with no prerequisites. On a successful attack, the target takes an additional +1 die of damage (matching your weapon's damage die). If the target is Marked (per the Mark ability), this increases to +2 dice instead.
